normative_policy: Gate is integrated into the active Project Factory runtime, not delivered as a decorative patch. Project delivery blocks on missing required materialization, trace, validator result, failcode or fallback.
schema_or_json_contract: Project artifact must be valid JSON when applicable and must expose concrete evidence fields required by the gate.
validator_integration: Validated by validate_h37_h51_artifacts() and generate_end_to_end() inside IDUNEX_PROJECT_FACTORY_v1.0.0.py.

golden_tests.positive: canonical generated project with required artifact and PASS status
golden_tests.negative: missing/empty/generic artifact or unsupported PASS must emit failcode

fallback_fixes: block official delivery when evidence is not executable or re-openable
no_regression: H01-H36 preserved; creative output remains uncertified globally.
